references.text: This verse in Matthew also speaks of the necessity of preaching the gospel to all nations before the end times come, which aligns with what Mark 13:10 says.
In Luke it is also emphasized that the gospel must be preached to all nations, reflecting the message in Mark 13:10.
Acts 1:8 speaks of the disciples being witnesses to the ends of the earth, which corresponds with the idea that the gospel must reach all nations first, as mentioned in Mark 13:10.

Revelation 14:6 speaks of an angel proclaiming an eternal gospel to all who live on the earth, to every nation and tribe and language and people, which agrees with the message in Mark 13:10 that the gospel must be preached to all nations.
